comment: A Log Analytics answer to the logical-disk '% Free Space' query, with rows — the only evidence that distinguishes the enhanced tier from baseline, because there is no platform metric for free space inside a VM. Rows present in the trailing 24 hours means the Azure Monitor Agent and its Data Collection Rule are actually delivering, so the preflight records `enhanced` (Req 12.8). Note the per-drive InstanceName values here are real drive letters; the recording of the AMA regression that collapses them to '_Total' belongs to the metrics tasks that must turn it into a gap.
